commit.message:
LU-17276 tests: skip sanity/105h for 2.16 interop

Skip sanity.sh test_105h during interop testing with 2.16 or earlier
MDS, since it depends on fixes landed in v2_16_51-35-gf785bca0a9.

Clean up subtest code style to match current guidelines.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Test-Parameters: testlist=sanity serverversion=2.16 env=ONLY=105,HONOR_EXCEPT=y
